entries.source: জাপানি ইয়েন ও বাংলাদেশি টাকার reference rate দেখুন এবং কোন ধরনের transfer channel আপনার পরিস্থিতিতে ভালো হতে পারে তা তুলনা করুন।
entries.target: ජපන් යෙන් සහ බංග්ලාදේශ ටකා reference rate එක බලන්න සහ ඔබේ තත්ත්වයට සුදුසු transfer channel වර්ගය කුමක්දැයි සංසන්දනය කරන්න.
Rate එක load වූ විට ගණනය පෙන්වනු ඇත.

entries.source: . Provider-এর actual send/receive rate ও fee আলাদা হতে পারে।
entries.target: . Provider ගේ actual send/receive rate සහ fee වෙනස් විය හැකිය.

entries.source: Japan থেকে JPY দিয়ে Bangladesh-এ BDT পাঠানো যায়; recipient bank account, bKash বা Nagad support থাকতে পারে। Fee ও delivery estimate transfer setup-এর সময় live দেখুন।
entries.target: Japan සිට JPY වලින් Bangladesh වෙත BDT යැවිය හැකිය; recipient bank account, bKash හෝ Nagad support තිබිය හැකිය. Fee සහ delivery estimate transfer setup එකේදී live බලන්න.

entries.source: বড় amount, formal bank trail বা specific beneficiary bank requirement থাকলে useful হতে পারে। Sending bank + intermediary + receiving bank fee আলাদা হতে পারে।
entries.target: විශාල amount, formal bank trail හෝ specific beneficiary bank requirement තිබේ නම් ප්‍රයෝජනවත් විය හැකිය. Sending bank + intermediary + receiving bank fee වෙන වෙනම විය හැකිය.

entries.source: Recipient-এর bank account না থাকলে cash pickup service useful হতে পারে। Availability, ID requirement, fee এবং exchange rate provider অনুযায়ী check করুন।
entries.target: Recipient ට bank account එකක් නැත්නම් cash pickup service එක ප්‍රයෝජනවත් විය හැකිය. Availability, ID requirement, fee සහ exchange rate provider අනුව check කරන්න.

entries.source: একটা provider সব সময় সবার জন্য best নয়
entries.target: එක් provider කෙනෙක් සැමවිටම සැමටම best නොවේ

entries.source: Live quote-এ recipient কত BDT পাবে সেটা তুলনা করুন। Wise-এর মতো online service সাধারণত সহজ comparison দেয়।
entries.target: Live quote එකේ recipient ට කොපමණ BDT ලැබේදැයි සංසන්දනය කරන්න. Wise වැනි online service සාමාන්‍යයෙන් පහසු comparison එකක් ලබාදේ.

entries.source: Transfer limit, source-of-funds document, bank compliance এবং total fee আগে দেখুন। শুধু headline FX rate দেখে সিদ্ধান্ত নেবেন না।
entries.target: Transfer limit, source-of-funds document, bank compliance සහ total fee කලින් බලන්න. Headline FX rate එක පමණක් බලා තීරණය නොගන්න.

entries.source: Delivery ETA + recipient method (bank/bKash/Nagad/cash) priority দিন। Fastest option সবসময় cheapest নাও হতে পারে।
entries.target: Delivery ETA + recipient method (bank/bKash/Nagad/cash) වලට priority දෙන්න. Fastest option එක සැමවිටම cheapest නොවිය හැකිය.

entries.source: এই page financial advice নয় এবং এখানে দেখানো FX rate provider quote নয়। টাকা পাঠানোর আগে provider-এর final fee, exchange rate, transfer limit, eligibility এবং recipient amount যাচাই করুন। Bangladesh-এর remittance incentive থাকলে eligibility/provider support আলাদাভাবে confirm করুন।
entries.target: මෙම page එක financial advice එකක් නොවන අතර මෙහි පෙන්වන FX rate එක provider quote එකක් නොවේ. මුදල් යැවීමට පෙර provider ගේ final fee, exchange rate, transfer limit, eligibility සහ recipient amount එක තහවුරු කරන්න. Bangladesh remittance incentive එකක් තිබේ නම් eligibility/provider support වෙනම confirm කරන්න.
